correctness.rationale: The solid-angle formula factors exactly as 1+q exp(i delta), with the correct atan2 branch. The derivative and two-branch inverse yield the three finite-q CDFs. The event area>pi is exactly delta>pi-arccos(1/q); its conditionally uniform endpoint coordinate and Taylor expansion yield W=1/U-U. Continuity of the folded-gap density yields universality and the prefactor. Analytic pointwise strict q-monotonicity proves stochastic identification. Independent spherical cosine/Girard numerics and deterministic quadrature corroborate every regime.

value.rationale: The support bifurcation at the equator, square-root onset, heavy-tailed conditional area overshoot and universal bias-insensitive endpoint law identify a natural singular transition for geodesic triangles built from a fixed pole and latitude samples. Exact distributions distinguish northern and southern colatitudes, unlike a related all-latitude triple model. The result is a complete natural conditional model with geometric sampling relevance, not merely a numerical or relabeling identity.
